post.description:
Bulk create or update assessments for a scan.

This is the primary endpoint for the automated triage engine.
When a single Kconfig rule invalidates 50 CVEs, use this endpoint
instead of 50 individual POST requests.

Behavior:
- If an assessment already exists for (scan_id, vulnerability_id), it's updated
- If no assessment exists, a new one is created
- All operations happen in a single transaction
- Audit entries are created for each assessment

Errors:
- 404 if scan_id doesn't exist or belongs to another customer
- 422 if any status value is invalid or a vulnerability_id doesn't exist

- ?scan_id=X&filter_layer=kconfig - Assessments made by Kconfig filtering

post.description:
Dispatch the matching pipeline for a scan (async, non-blocking).

Returns immediately with status='queued'. The DBOS worker process
(run via `python manage.py run_dbos_worker`) picks up the workflow
and runs SBOM parse → CVE match → Kconfig/DTB filter → Assessment creation.

Poll /{scan_id}/status/ to track progress:
  - analysing:  pipeline running
  - triage:     complete, awaiting human review
  - failed:     pipeline error — check error_message in status response

carry_forward options:
  - true (default): reuse explicitly-reviewed assessments from the most
    recent completed scan where component name+version is unchanged.
    Respects zero-false-negative gate: only human-reviewed assessments
    with status=not_affected are carried; auto_pending are never carried.
  - false: run full matching from scratch.

get.description:
Poll scan status and analysis statistics.

Used by the CLI to display progress after triggering analysis.
Returns error_message when status == 'failed'.

CRA readiness verdict for a scan.

Returns a single verdict (shippable / not_ready / incomplete / pending)
with a checklist of CRA article-mapped items, compliance percentage,
blockers, and warnings. Never fails — always returns a verdict.

post.description:
Generate a compliance report for a scan.

Supported formats:
  - article13  — Article 13 Technical File (PDF)
  - vex_cdx    — CycloneDX VEX (JSON)
  - vex_csaf   — CSAF VEX (JSON)

Generation is synchronous for P1. The response is returned only after the
report is fully generated. For P2-005 (DBOS async), this will return 202
immediately with a report ID to poll.

get.description: Get metadata and status for a previously generated report.

Download a report.

PDF on S3: returns JSON with a presigned URL (client downloads from S3 directly).
PDF on disk: streams bytes through Django.
JSON formats: returns JSON bytes inline.

- 202 if report is still generating (with Retry-After header)
- 409 if report generation failed

Direct export — returns JSON immediately, no Report record created.

Suitable for CI pipelines that need a machine-readable artifact fast.
Supported formats: vex_cdx, sbom_cdx, sbom_vex_cdx, sarif.

If check_schema=true, CycloneDX output is validated against the 1.5 JSON schema;
a 422 is returned if validation fails (useful for CI quality gates).

Download a CRA Evidence Pack ZIP for a scan.

One-click bundle of all compliance artifacts: SBOM, VEX, Article 13 PDF,
suppression rationale CSV, CRA readiness, scan metadata, and README.

Graceful degradation: if any artifact fails, the ZIP is assembled without
it and a note is added to the README.
